{"subject":"Quillpath for vCluster's new AE and SDR hires","body":"Hi Laurie,

vCluster has 7 open sales roles, including Federal Account Executive, Enterprise Account Executive and SDR roles in NYC and the SF Bay Area. The newest was posted 4 days ago.

With more reps and a wider top of funnel, there will be more deals to review. Quillpath reads your CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) every night, flags stalled deals each morning, and gives each rep a short list of next actions per deal. Setup takes about 15 minutes, read-only, with nothing to migrate.

Would you like to run a free 14-day pilot on your real pipeline before the new reps start?","missing":["Whether vCluster uses HubSpot or Salesforce as its CRM","Whether a pipeline review process already exists for the international team","Start dates for the new hires"]}
